method: Every entry and every property checked statically, excluding getters/spreads/computed names/executable initializers/duplicate fields. Additional literal fields fully reported; no narrowing of allowed extras. Show all code outside the verified array and require manual scope/export/build review. Exact effective-input bytes bind only one-file creations equal to final source; other inputs must be reviewed in full. Diagnostic helper, not a new model endpoint.
